sloka: तस्य वेगसमुद्धूतं जलं सजलदं तदा ।अम्बर्स्थं विबभ्राज शारदाभ्रमिवाततम् ॥५-१-७३॥
transliteration: tasya vegasamuddhūtaṁ jalaṁ sajaladaṁ tadā ।ambarsthaṁ vibabhrāja śāradābhramivātatam ॥5-1-73॥

translations.english: Then the water raised by his onrush along with the cloud widely spread in the sky shone like an outstreched autumnal cloud.
